signal: Softeon was acquired by IFS in March 2026, creating IFS Softeon to extend Industrial AI into WMS

email.body1:
Chris, saw IFS completed its acquisition of Softeon to extend Industrial AI into warehouse management.

An acquisition that size usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before territories settle, and that is where deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Softeon off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for Softeon.

Post-acquisition, the combined pipeline target tends to jump faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Softeon needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for Softeon.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged.

I pulled a benchmark of how Softeon's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while the integration settles, no problem at all. The post-acquisition stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Softeon either way.
